interpretation: Decoded geolocated pixel visits for selected native swaths. Counts and cloud fractions are not area fractions, complete-day visibility, or NASA Aqua/VIIRS standard-product observation denominators. Unsampled space/time remains unknown. Classification is verified against file legends and alignment, not independently validated physical cloud truth.
